protocol_name: LOCO Few-shot Adaptation Extension — Final Pre-Test Lock
amendment_timing: Finalized after structural A00 preflight and before any adaptation training or adapted Test inference.
amendments_from_preliminary_v1: Forecast head is now bound exactly to state_dict parameters head.0.*, head.3.*, and head.6.*; all lstm.* parameters remain frozen.
Frozen LSTM backbone is kept in eval mode during adaptation so recurrent dropout is disabled; the MLP head is kept in train mode so head dropout remains active.
ReduceLROnPlateau is removed from adaptation. A fixed learning rate of 1e-4 is used in both selection and refit so the refit training trajectory is reproducible without reusing target validation.

Budget windows are enumerated from the full 2022-2023 cold-start validation frame and then filtered by complete target-horizon containment. The dataframe is not sliced to the budget before window construction.

Target-city adaptation-validation checkpoint monitoring uses the frozen source correction and the unchanged physical postprocessing; the correction itself is never reselected or refit on target-city labels.

scientific_scope.purpose: Estimate the value of recent target-city labeled PV-target history for adapting a frozen multi-city cold-start model to a previously unseen city.
scientific_scope.starting_model: Frozen H24/H48 cold-start source checkpoint for the same held-out city and seed.
scientific_scope.track: Cold-start only: 34 predictors and zero PV-target-history predictors at inference.
scientific_scope.target_labels: Normalized physics-based AC PV target used by the study; not metered plant production.
scientific_scope.adaptation_source_period: Target-city labels from 2023 only, physically stored in the original 2022-2023 validation file but unused by the source fold because the target city was held out.
scientific_scope.independent_test: Exactly the already frozen 2024-2025 Stage 60/80 grids.
scientific_scope.test_seal: No adapted Test inference before A10+A20 selection/refit and A30 adapted-checkpoint freeze are all PASS/CLOSED.

window_policy.budget_interpretation: Budget counts local labeled target hours/days, not all local meteorological observations.
window_policy.nested_recent_budgets: 30d subset of 90d subset of 365d, all ending 2023-12-31.
window_policy.interpretive_caveat: Budget size and seasonal coverage are intentionally linked in this deployment-style recent-history design; results quantify recent labeled-history budgets rather than a pure sample-size intervention.

optimization.loss: same strict weighted Huber as source model
optimization.early_stopping_monitor: target-city adaptation-validation daylight RMSE after frozen source correction and unchanged postprocessing
optimization.refit: Restore the original source checkpoint, reset the same seed, and train on the full budget for exactly best_epoch using the same fixed optimizer settings; do not consult target validation during refit.

frozen_source_artifacts.x_scaler: one source-trained scaler per held-out fold/horizon; never refit on target city
frozen_source_artifacts.y_scaler: one source-trained scaler per held-out fold/horizon; never refit on target city
frozen_source_artifacts.correction: source-validation-selected per seed; frozen and retained; never recalibrated from target labels

order: A30 freeze all 270 adapted checkpoints — no Test
